description: The latest transactions of any wallet on Base, normalized for agents: hash, direction (in/out), counterparty address and explorer name, native value, method called, status, fee and timestamp. Up to 50 per call from public explorer data. The history layer of the wallet-intelligence shelf. Pay-per-call via x402 (USDC, Base).

_payment.description: Optional base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE payload. Omit to receive payment requirements.
